If your director is out of office, ask your manager to approve on their behalf or contact Procurement & AP to reroute the requisition. Don’t create a second requisition for the same purchase while this one is pending.

questions.text: My laptop battery dies after an hour. Can I get a new one?
articles: Getting your laptop repaired or replaced

result.answer: You can request help, but a new laptop isn’t guaranteed. First restart your laptop and install pending updates. Then in ServiceNow, open Employee Center > Report a Problem > Laptop, describe the battery issue, and include the asset tag from the sticker on the bottom. IT will troubleshoot or arrange a swap. Laptops are normally replaced every 4 years; earlier replacement depends on whether IT decides repair isn’t worthwhile.
